raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (349 rows, exactly the source_tz='UTC' rows) was delivered with UTC timestamps instead of America/Chicago local time. Its evening transactions (18:00-22:55 CST) therefore appear as 00:00-04:55 on 2026-01-17, which inflates that day's count and shifts its times outside opening hours. Converting UTC rows to Chicago local time fixes txn_ts and txn_date; all data falls in January, so CST (UTC-6) applies throughout with no DST change.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
